sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Area Scaling Factor
lecture_lines: Linear transformations stretch the space around us.
Determinants measure the factor of area change.
A unit square transformed creates a parallelogram.
If area doubles, the determinant is two.
It quantifies how space scales during transformation.
animations: Animate transformation of square by 2x2 matrix.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The 2x2 Basic Calculation
lecture_lines: Determinants for two by two matrices use ad-bc.
Cross multiply vectors to find the area change.
Example: a matrix with result six scales area.
animations: Display 2x2 matrix A with elements in #00FFFF.
Animate calculation steps by highlighting a, d, b, c.

sections.title: Geometric Signification: Orientation and Zero
lecture_lines: Negative determinants indicate a mirror-image flip.
A zero determinant collapses shapes into lines.
Zero means the transformation loses a dimension.
animations: Show flipping orientation via reflection animation.
Demonstrate area shrinking to zero with collinear vectors.

sections.title: Scaling to 3D: Volume Interpretation
lecture_lines: Extend the concept to three dimensions now.
Determinants represent the volume scaling factor.
Transformations shrink or expand volumes in space.
animations: Animate transformation of cube by 3x3 matrix.

sections.title: Application and Summary
lecture_lines: Determinants solve systems and simplify integration.
Matrices represent transformations, determinants the scaling.
These tools are fundamental in applied mathematics.
animations: Summarize Determinant as scaling factor in #FFFFFF.
Fade out elements with a final text: 'Determinant'.
